description.value: The Best Western Plus Merritt Hotel is an 83-room property billed as Merritt's largest and most contemporary hotel, situated just off the Coquihalla Highway at the gateway to the Nicola Valley. It offers a complimentary full breakfast and modern amenities in a location well-positioned for cyclists travelling the interior BC corridor. The surrounding Nicola Valley provides access to outdoor recreation and the town's services.
